reason: No Clanwilliam Van Wyk owner is named Henning or Henning Jacobus. The only overlap with any candidate is a shared middle name Jacobus, which is not enough.
Petrus Gerhardus Cilliers in Graaff-Reinet matches his given names exactly. Colesberg was part of Graaff-Reinet, so the district fits.
Casper Hendrik Badenhorst in Somerset matches his name and declared district. The note 'sv Hendrik' fits a father recorded as Casper Hendrik Sr, who could plausibly be called by his second name.
Jacobus Francois Du Toit in Graaff-Reinet has the same two given names in reversed order, a normal variation. Colesberg lay within Graaff-Reinet, and no other candidate shares both names.
No Steyn owner bears the names Theunis, Frederik or Jacobus. The candidates are Hans Jurgen, Hermanus, Douw Gerbrand and Stephanus Johannes, all clearly different.
The only Beaufort Strydom owner is Jan Lodewyk, which is a clearly different given name from Pieter Frederik.
Schalk Willem Bruwer in Swellendam matches both his full given names and his declared district exactly. No other candidate shares these names.
No Graaff-Reinet Smit owner is named Christiaan or Christiaan Hendrik Stephanus. A plain 'Hendrik' (C07) shares only his second name, which is too weak.
None of the 23 Graaff-Reinet Pretorius owners is named Daniel or Daniel Petrus.
No Fourie owner is named Willem or Willem Andries Johannes. The Johannes and Petrus Johannes candidates share only a later name, and C05 is a deceased estate.
